llm.summary: This skill coherently generates Chinese software copyright registration materials from user-provided code and can optionally help fill the official website without auto-submitting.

dimensions.detail: The artifact purpose matches its capabilities: it reads a user-specified code repository or directory and README, generates DOCX/Markdown registration materials, and optionally assists with form filling on the official registration site.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The workflow asks for user-provided inputs, discloses local code scanning and output files, requires user confirmation before online filling, and explicitly forbids automatic submission.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No unusual install behavior is present; the package contains markdown instructions and three Python generator scripts, with no automatic execution or hidden installer.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Reading source code and generating documents is necessary for the stated purpose, but the generated source document may include sensitive code or secrets if the user includes them in the selected directory.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The reviewed scripts do not create persistence, escalate privileges, collect credentials, or make network calls; optional website interaction is user-directed and uses a visible browser session.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing, use it only on a code directory you are comfortable turning into registration materials. Review the generated DOCX and Markdown files for secrets, passwords, API keys, internal URLs, or proprietary content before uploading anything, and confirm all website actions manually since the skill is intended to assist rather than submit automatically.
llm.findings: [LP3] expected: The skill does read local source files and write output documents, but that behavior is central to the stated registration-material workflow and is disclosed in the instructions and skill card. The lack of formal permission declarations is a transparency limitation, not evidence of malicious behavior.
